sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit filed today by learned counsel for the applicants is taken on record.
Learned Counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State are present.
No one is present on behalf of opposite party no. 2.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that it is a matrimonial dispute between the parties.

The coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 23.05.2022 passed in Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No. 1505 of 2021 has referred the matter to the Medication and Conciliation Centre,
High Court, Allahabad.

sentences.text:
In compliance of the order of this Court, both the parties have appeared before the Medication and Conciliation Centre, High Court, Allahabad on several dates and it was agreed between the parties that they have filed divorce petition with mutual consent and all the criminal and civil cases filed by them or their family members against each other shall be set aside /
withdrawn by them by taking appropriate steps before the Court / Authorities concerned.

In view of above, since the husband and wife have settled their disputes and the present application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. is on behalf of parents of husband is also liable to be allowed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In compliance of the order of this Court, both the parties have appeared before the Medication and Conciliation Centre, High Court, Allahabad on several dates and it was agreed between the parties that they have filed divorce petition with mutual consent and all the criminal and civil cases filed by them or their family members against each other shall be set aside /
withdrawn by them by taking appropriate steps before the Court / Authorities concerned.
It was also agreed that the terms and conditions of the settlement shall also be applicable to Application U/s 482 No. 4844/22 and Application U/s 482 No.
6277/22 pending before this Court.
In view of above, since the husband and wife have settled their disputes and the present application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. is on behalf of parents of husband is also liable to be allowed.
The application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 14386/9 of 2020.
(State vs. Parichay Tyagi and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 0414 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3 & 4 D.P. Act, Police Station Charthawal, District Muzaffar Nagar are hereby quashed.
